<role>
You check one property (duplicate) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is the core problem still open, not solved by a shipped story and not covered by a roadmap item? Pass means yes.
Compare the problem itself, not the product area. A spike that is unstarted or in progress is not shipped.
Fail if a completed story solves the same problem, or a roadmap item already covers it.
The evidence is the problem statement and the five most similar stories and roadmap pages, with status and dates.
</definition>

response.content: {"critique": "The problem is reserve changes stuck in approval queues when the designated approver is unavailable and no delegate is assigned. I checked the five most similar items: policyholder milestone notifications, supplier address fields, claim information display, reserve history audit export, and bulk document upload. None address approver unavailability, delegation, or approval-queue halts; the closest, 'Reserve history audit export,' concerns compliance exports of reserve adjustments, not approvals, and the only completed story (bulk upload) is unrelated. No shipped story or roadmap item covers this problem.", "verdict": "pass"}
